Name: Chick Chick Chicky
Overview: Play the new co-op or single player mode as Chicky &/or Ducky in this new fantastic HD game based on an all time classic... Collect a super feather and power up to turn the tables on the enemy kitty! Become "Super Chicky" or "Angry Ducky"! Features Jump-in and Jump-out Co-op play! "Harvest Fun in Chick Chick Chicky"
